title: Final drift velocity expression
description: Essential: The response must provide the correct final formula for the drift velocity: v_d = (U M) / (n e ρ ρ_0 L).

title: Apply Ohm's Law
description: Important: The solution must correctly relate the applied voltage U to the current I using the conductor's resistance R = ρ_0 L / S.

title: Relate current to drift velocity
description: Important: The solution must derive the microscopic current I = n_e e v_d S, where n_e is the free electron density.

title: Calculate electron density
description: Important: The solution must correctly express the free electron density n_e as (n ρ N_A) / M using the given macroscopic parameters.

title: Correct algebraic manipulation
description: Optional: The solution shows clear, logical steps in combining the equations to solve for v_d without algebraic errors.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The final expression or intermediate steps demonstrate that the units for velocity (m/s) are obtained.

title: Confusing resistivity and density
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the symbols ρ (density) and ρ_0 (resistivity) are swapped or used incorrectly in formulas.

title: Missing charge carrier link
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the connection between molar quantity (n, M, N_A) and the number density of free electrons is omitted or wrong.
